snippet.title: Through Blood and Dragons - Dragon Wars Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars is a third-person, fantasy-themed, on-rails shooter for a single player; players take the role of an archer on the back of a dragon AND the dragon itself through short first-person dragon-breath segments. 

Download the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793750/Through_Blood_and_Dragons__Dragon_Wars/
